title: Closed observation query
description: Arguments of the built-in P3 tool observations_query and the common bricks of a closed observation query. The series, subject, window and rollup are taken from enums within the role's insight.observes (for an aggregator within sources, for a job worker within the task type's observes) and the task mark; reading does not set untrusted_seen, points of another tenant are not visible (OBV-3, TEN-4). The group_by parameter exists only for an aggregator.

subject.description: Subject; without it, with group_by, rollups over many subjects within the aggregator's sources are returned.

group_by.description: Only for an aggregator: the subject kind to group rollups by, within its sources (AGG-2).

series.description: Name of an observation series: a core series from core-series.yaml (for example farm.task.outcome) or a tenant series (metadata.name of an ObservationSeries manifest, for example host.load.v1). In a bot query the value comes from an enum within the role's insight.observes, the aggregator's sources or the task type's observes (OBV-3).

subject.description: Subject of the series: kind and id from the catalog of one's own tenant or the name of a tenant object, for example task_type:demo.db.backup.v1, schedule:report-nightly, host:db1, dataset:ctd-2026.

window.description: Read window from a closed list (OBV-3).

rollup.description: Rollup from the closed list spec/model/rollups.yaml (OBV-4).

value.description: Value of a point or rollup: a number or an enum value of the series. There is no free text (OBV-2, INJ-1).
